findings.description: DM Development and Ascentris close a $61.7 million PNC construction loan on the 152-unit, nine-story 321 Florida in the Mission; paywalled after the lede. Under construction financing but a not-yet-built building: no building-block fields.

publish.note: Declined: 309–321 Florida already carries this project's 27 Aug permit entry and the 4 Sept 'break ground this fall' entry; a loan closing is financing news for the same project, paywalled after the lede, and adds nothing the timeline needs.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 321 FLORIDA ST → parcel 3965022; sf-parcels has blklot 3965022 active, 309–321 FLORIDA; the 2025 roll records it as miscellaneous/mixed-use, built 1957.
